page.layout: One page of text, centred title block. Faded show-through lines at the top are not printed on this page and are left out. Below the title block, a catchword at the right.
page.notes: Faded lines at the top of the page are show-through from the reverse and are not transcribed. The word "LECTO-" at the lower right is a catchword, the start of the following page (Lectori). The woodcut-like flourish after "fide" is a printer's ornament, not text.
